name: Option 1 storm
title: Atmospheric Lighthouse Storm - Clean & Borderless Standard
description: Balanced realistic maritime storm featuring silky smooth DOF rain, atmospheric volumetric cloud churn, distant village lights, feathered lighthouse beam, and natural borderless background dissolution with unobstructed ocean waves.

specs.rain_drops: ~540 heterogeneous streaks (3 optical depth layers: 44% far mist, 45% focal in-focus, 11% near bokeh)
specs.clouds: 4 procedural multi-lobed volumetric clusters + 8 low scud vapor wisps
specs.lightning: Procedural branching fractal strikes deep in background with ambient flash wash
specs.lighting_beam: Multi-pass Gaussian feathered beam (shadowBlur=18, zero hard cut edges)
specs.distant_lights: Twinkling cottage lamps mapped to cliff cottages and secondary rhythmic lighthouse beacon
specs.framing: Borderless with soft radial edge mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 98% 90% at 50% 50%, #000 76%, transparent 100%)
specs.wave_rendering: Pure, unobstructed fine-art painting (zero artificial splash/mist sprites)
